description.content:
Generates a valuation report, based on a previous AVM request for '**origination**' requests for the `SALE` / `RENT` / `AVM Plus` / `AVM Pro` Requests.

    Note: **Enquiry** PDF requests are not supportive.
    Endpoint /api/v1/reports/valuations/sale/{valuationId}/pdf was **`deprecated`** in March 2025.

variable.description: (Required) Unique valuation identifier, generated from an AVM response
